name: Faultline adversary
description: Adversarial traffic agent for testing automated cars: 0G model 0gm-1.0-35b-a3b on the 0G Router private tier (TeeML) picks one discrete action per 1 s checkpoint for the lead car (lead_brake) or the cutting-in car (cut_in); a deterministic controller owns all physics and falls back to SAFE_HALT on any failure. Episodes are committed on EpisodeRegistryV2 before the first call and published on 0G Storage.
